principle: accountId and accNum are DIFFERENT provider-native identities and are NEVER collapsed into one integer. TradeLocker account identity binds environment + accountId + accNum + server.

provider_native.accountId: integer id used in REST paths: /trade/accounts/{accountId}/...
provider_native.accNum: integer account number used in the accNum HTTP header
provider_native.server: broker server name used at login (/auth/jwt/token body)
provider_native.environment: base URL environment (demo/live) — R5 uses demo base only in code/config, never connected

generic_binding.account_id: bound EconomicTarget -> TradeLockerBrokerSession execution path; provider adapter NEVER chooses the account
generic_binding.ownership_truth: logical strategy id + runtime id + account id + provider order id + provider position id

multi_account.session_model: ONE authenticated session manages MULTIPLE authorized accounts where the API contract permits
multi_account.discovery: GET /auth/jwt/all-accounts (read-only) returns id, accNum, name per account
multi_account.isolation: each GenericRuntime instance keeps separate runtime_id, account binding, ledger, desired state; NO cross-account ownership contamination (test_08/test_50)
multi_account.unlike_mt5: MT5 local-terminal deployment is one process/terminal per account; TradeLocker is a native multi-account REST session — the provider supports both models without generic changes
